source.author: hor
source.text: cur nescire pudens prave quam discere malo?
source.text_original: cur nescire pudens prave quam discere malo?
source.text_english: Why should I, ashamed to be ignorant, prefer to do wrong rather than to learn?

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Nec Horatium audiunt commonentem: Cur nescire pudens prave, quam discere malo?
reuse.text_original: Nec Horatium audiunt commonentem: Cur nescire pudens prave, quam discere malo?
reuse.text_english: Nor do they listen to Horace when he warns: Why is it shameful to be ignorant, rather than, by learning, to correct what is wrong?
